thread:
IncidentBot: Pager triggered: embeddings-prod > 95th latency threshold for 5m. severity: high. paging oncall: Leah.

Leah: I’m looking. seeing elevated tail latencies on embeddings v2 behind the inference router.

Leah: quick check — rolling deploy to embeddings cluster started ~20m ago? @Ravi can you confirm deploys?

Ravi: yep, deploy kicked at 1772499800 (rolling). I see a spike in GPU-side queue depth on node pool e-embed-*.

Marta: impacted customers: a subset of low-throughput embedding requests are timing out at 10s for ~30% of calls. product reports small set of customers on dedicated capacity.

Leah: mitigation plan: 1) disable new routing weight for embeddings-v2 (rollback traffic) 2) increase request timeout fallback to 15s for router for any in-flight requests 3) scale pool by +2 nodes. Starting step 1 now.

Ravi: rolling back route weight to v1 now. command: `redwood-router set-weight embeddings-v2 0.0 --circuit=prod`

Arjun: autoscaler policy not firing because nodes are marked draining. I can force-add nodes: `infra add-node e-embed-large --reason "incident 1772501234"`

Leah: OK rollback applied. seeing 50% reduction in tail. initiating scale.

IncidentBot: Note: deployment rollback initiated by Leah at 1772501450.

Leah: continuing to monitor. Sam (product) — can you flag any customer slack tickets or support threads? need impact window for postmortem.

Sam (product): notified CS and pushed initial note to affected customers. Collecting impacted org IDs, will post list in #support-alerts.

Marta: Web dashboard shows error spike from 17:02–17:18 UTC. estimate 16 minutes of elevated errors.

Leah: ok looks stable at p95 now within SLO. closing pager in 10m if no regressions.

Ravi: node add succeeded and new nodes joined pool. CPU/GPU metrics normalizing.

oncall-handoff-bot: Handoff reminder: Leah please handoff to next oncall before you sign off.

Leah: brief summary for handoff: cause: v2 routing + drained nodes prevented autoscale -> queue depth spike -> timeouts. mitigation: rolled routing back to v1, forced scale, increased router timeout as short-term fallback. customer impact: ~16m p95 latency/timeout window affecting subset of customers on dedicated pools.

Leah: action items I want tracked:
- ACTION-1 assign@Ravi: investigate why draining nodes prevented autoscaler from adding capacity; add guard in autoscaler to consider draining=true nodes.
- ACTION-2 assign@Marta: correlate affected org_ids with billing/contract tiers and confirm customer communication complete.
- ACTION-3 assign@Arjun: add runbook step to force-scale via infra CLI and add exact commands.
- ACTION-4 assign@Leah: schedule postmortem + include perf traces and router config snapshot.

Ravi: ack ACTION-1. I’ll open an infra ticket with logs and root cause analysis. ETA EOD tomorrow.

Marta: ack ACTION-2. I’ll post the org_ids to #support-alerts and sync with CS.

Arjun: ack ACTION-3. I’ll draft runbook snippet now and push PR to docs repo.

Leah: scheduling postmortem — proposing Fri 1772560000 (4 days) at 16:00 UTC; will invite SRE, infra, product, and CS. Who can attend?

Sam (product): I’ll be there.

Ravi: I can make it.

Marta: I’m in.

Arjun: attending.

Leah: I’ll create the postmortem doc and link it here. proto: https://confluence.internal/redwood/postmortems/1772501234 (placeholder) — will add timeline, mitigation commands, prometheus/grafana snapshots, and the action items list.

Leah: runbook edits proposed (snippet):
```
name: embeddings-tail-latency
trigger:
  - metric: embeddings_router_p95_latency
    threshold_ms: 2000
    duration: 5m
steps:
  - check: node_pool_drain_status
  - if: drain_count > 0 and autoscaler_inhibited
    then: force_scale_nodes
  - rollback: routing_weight set to previous stable model
  - escalate: paging to infra and product
```

Leah: please review runbook PR and land before the postmortem if possible. I’ll include automated test for the autoscaler guard.

Ravi: will add logs and alert rule link in the PR.

Marta: tagging CS: @CS-team for follow-up comms for affected customers.

Leah: final handoff to next oncall @Arjun: oncall until 1772530000. main follow-ups: ACTION-1 (Ravi), ACTION-2 (Marta), ACTION-3 (Arjun). If regressions show up escalate to pager.

Arjun: taking handoff. thanks. I’ll watch for regressions and follow up on runbook PR.

Leah: thanks all. closing thread and will attach postmortem link when ready. :thumbsup:
